contributions.title: Spymaster
contributions.shortDescription: Innerspace VR's last VR espionage game, where I contributed to gameplay features and engine systems development using Unreal Engine 5.
contributions.longDescription: Contributed to the development of Spymaster, a VR espionage game by Innerspace VR, by implementing gameplay features and engine systems using Unreal Engine 5. Focused on integrating and optimizing multi-headset VR/MR support, improving stability and performance across various immersive platforms.
